subject: U-CHAIN round 1 NO-GO verdict published
body: Aggregated all three review axes and held bot findings, posted the receipted COMMENTED NO-GO round 1 review on PR #484, and pushed report-only evidence commit 5619d5bef30b8944c4c18bedd01cdaaabe37d403 to ravidsrk/u-chain. Reviewed code SHA 5328cc866d3b213c444687b9c7d9cb2d1d45d853 has nine Required axis findings and three unresolved VALID held bot findings; validation passed and 1707 tests reproduced the same five existing failures.
